answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the haven of a task receipt, and the tide is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a academic prose with citations to prior work register, it stays short.
